نتزامن (form VI)
# نَتَزَامَنُ (natazāmanu) /na.ta.zaː.ma.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَزَامَنَ (tazāmana)
# نَتَزَامَنَ (natazāmana) /na.ta.zaː.ma.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَزَامَنَ (tazāmana)
# نَتَزَامَنْ (natazāman) /na.ta.zaː.man/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَزَامَنَ (tazāmana)
